summary: Tested ACTOOS PRO Technician App. Main bug FIXED: 'Accepter' button now works correctly (user.id fix applied). Found 2 additional issues: 1) Missing XCircle import (FIXED), 2) Database schema issues blocking Start intervention and Devis loading.

critical.issue: Database error: 'date_debut' column does not exist in interventions table. Error: PGRST204
Database error: 'created_by' column does not exist in devis table. Error: 42703

ui_bugs.issue: Missing XCircle import from lucide-react causing runtime error - FIXED by adding import

integration_issues.issue: Cannot start intervention due to missing 'date_debut' column in database
Devis list fails to load due to missing 'created_by' column in devis table

action_items: Add 'date_debut' column to interventions table in Supabase database
Add 'created_by' column to devis table in Supabase database OR update technicianApi.getDevisForTech query to not use created_by filter

supabaseApi.js line 1175-1193: technicianApi.startIntervention sets date_debut but column doesn't exist in interventions table
